title: CULTURE IN A FRAME: C3B AS A COMIC-BASED BENCHMARK FOR MULTIMODAL CULTURALLY AWARENESS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on a comic-based benchmark (C3B) through tasks such as background culture identification, culture-aware object detection, and cultural conflict understanding, specifically measuring accuracy disparities across 77 distinct Western and non-Western cultures.

Assessing culturally-aligned content generation via multimodal machine translation tasks across five different target languages (English, German, Russian, Spanish, and Thai) to measure performance disparities between high-resource and low-resource languages.
